svg.title: H2 time evolution: Trotter steps against exact evolution
svg.text: H2 time evolution: Trotter steps against exact evolution
Both electrons start in the lower orbital. The Hamiltonian keeps moving them, together, to the upper one and back.

Both orders give the same populations here; only the state error tells them apart.
